reproduced without change. The statement comparison (comparator) checks the four theorems
of `comparator.json`, each stated in `Challenge.lean` against its proof in `Solution.lean`:
the two forms of Theorem 1.1 under three inputs, and (since v0.9.0) the proof of

internal, whose statements no second checker compared; the page reports them as "Built, not

says what the paper says is the comparison the page asks the reader to make.
